name: China, Regulations for the Implementation of the Road Traffic Safety Law, article 51 (right-hand traffic)
status: draft: written from the regulation as I recall it, not checked against the current text and not validated on any data. Confirm with a local traffic-law expert before using results.
notes: Where signs or markings control the junction the vehicle with priority goes first.
Without them: stop and look, yield to the vehicle on the right-hand road, a turning vehicle yields to one going straight, and an oncoming right turner yields to a left turner.
All-way stops with an arrival order are not a Chinese convention, so first_arrival is false here.
